sections.name: questions
sections.label: Questions
sections.content: Does a Web editor parent domain exist, with Evidence-backed writing and Website copy refining it, or does Website copy keep refining Evidence-backed writing? Is a domain's priority a period of its own (programme periods per domain) or a rank inside the shared period? What is the affirmation act in a domain view: the existing fork into Affirmed, or the confidence tip? Which tool hosts the domain view: the control room in srs-lab, srs-web, or the clerk desk? How is a localised axis name recorded without a new axis-in-domain copy?
